crossRefs.note: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful…
Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of…
Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit…
When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”
The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the…
When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers, to receive his fruit.
You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

translations.web: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus told this parable: “A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.
translations.kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
translations.asv: And he spake this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came seeking fruit thereon, and found none.
